items.explanation: The words "patiently" and "student" have been interchanged. An adverb must modify "explained" and "every" must be followed by a noun, so "The teacher student explained" and "every patiently could understand" make no sense.
The words "throughout" and "near" have been interchanged. Rain falls "throughout the night", and the fields lie "near the village"; "fell near the night" does not make sense.
The sentence is already correct: "carefully" is the adverb of "repaired", "broken" describes the clock, "perfect" describes the time it keeps and "cold" describes the winter.

The words "during" and "because" have been interchanged. "during the summer" needs a preposition before the noun phrase and "because" must introduce the clause "the weather is pleasant"; the swapped sentence breaks both.

The words "new" and "problem" have been interchanged. "The new manager" needs the adjective, and "solve the problem" needs a noun as the object; "solve the new before the end of the week" is incomplete and meaningless.
The sentence is already correct: "improves" is the verb of the second action, "concentrate" follows "helps students", and "long" describes the hours. No interchange is needed.

The words "meaning" and "pronounced" have been interchanged. "explains the meaning of a word" needs a noun, and "should be pronounced" needs a participle; "the pronounced of a word" and "should be meaning" are ungrammatical.

The words "quickly" and "catch" have been interchanged. An adverb must modify "walked", and "to catch" needs an infinitive verb with an object; "walked catch to the station" and "to quickly the morning train" are ungrammatical.

The words "planted" and "look" have been interchanged. "The students planted several young trees" needs a transitive past verb, and "would look greener" needs a base verb after "would"; "would planted greener" is ungrammatical.

The words "attract" and "until" have been interchanged. "to attract customers" needs an infinitive verb and "until the following week" needs a preposition-like time word; "to until customers" and "offer attract the following week" make no sense.

The words "quiet" and "pleasure" have been interchanged. "the quiet river path" needs an adjective before the noun phrase, and "a simple pleasure" needs a noun; "the pleasure river path" and "a simple quiet that many elderly residents enjoy" do not work.

The words "depend" and "delayed" have been interchanged. "Farmers ... depend on" needs the verb, and "a delayed monsoon" needs the participle as an adjective; "Farmers delayed on" and "a depend monsoon" are ungrammatical.

The words "hoping" and "learn" have been interchanged. "hoping that" introduces the wish, and "will visit and learn" needs a base verb after "will"; "learn that more families" and "will visit and hoping" are ungrammatical.

The words "finishing" and "carefully" have been interchanged. "After finishing the experiment" needs a verb form after "After", and an adverb must modify "recorded"; "After carefully the experiment" is ungrammatical.
The words "carry" and "travel" have been interchanged. People "carry cameras, maps or music players" (transitive) but "travel abroad" (intransitive); "travel cameras" and "carry abroad" do not work.

The words "between" and "encourage" have been interchanged. "between the two towns" needs a preposition and "should encourage trade" needs a verb after "should"; "shorten the journey encourage the two towns" and "should between trade" are ungrammatical.
